questions.q: Which is a biotic feature of a coastal ecosystem?
questions.why: Biotic means living; mangroves are living organisms. The others are abiotic.

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of soft engineering?
questions.why: Beach replenishment works with natural processes; the others are hard structures.

questions.q: A disadvantage of groynes is that they
options: trap sediment so beaches further down the coast are starved and erode faster
are cheaper than all other defences
destroy the beach in front of them
questions.why: Groynes trap sediment, which starves beaches downdrift of material and increases erosion there.

questions.q: Explain how agriculture can threaten a coastal ecosystem such as a coral reef.
questions.model: Fertiliser and soil runoff carried by rivers into the sea add nutrients causing algal blooms. These block sunlight and use up oxygen, damaging the coral. Pesticides can also poison marine life.
points: fertiliser / sediment runoff enters the sea
algal bloom blocks light / removes oxygen, harming coral
